scope: Illustrations alternatives des quatre gardiens du catalogue. Aucun changement de carte native, profil ou gameplay.

cards.name: Vessa
cards.title: Un abri dans le vent
cards.costume: Manteau-rempart perlé, uniforme turquoise et blanc, casque Aéro à grandes ailettes.
cards.crystal: Au fermoir d'épaule et aux attaches des ailettes ; des filets d'air suivent les plaques.
cards.scene: Sur une passerelle d'altitude, elle ouvre son manteau pour abriter la voie de secours.

original.name: VESSA
original.description: Vessa ne nomme jamais un sauvetage une victoire. Son bâton déroule un fil entre les toits ; ses mains refont les nœuds. Le bleu de son uniforme demeure quand les nuages avalent le monde.

cards.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE new Kalistar portrait 4:5 illustration, no frame, card UI, text or watermark.
Image 1 is the specific existing Nestown character: preserve their recognizable face, feather colors, gender, physique, signature equipment and clothing vocabulary, but create a coherent NEW scene and pose. Image 2 is the MANTEAU-REMPART equipment concept ONLY: transfer its physical articulated cape/shield mechanism, NOT its Drax face, horns, red-black uniform, sword, heat or setting. Image 3 is Momo for KALISTAR PAINTING style only.
Strict painterly Kalistar DA: broad deliberate visible brushwork, sculpted painted volumes, rich textile/metal grain, hierarchic edges and cinematic motivated light. Not photographic, smooth 3D, anime or flat comic. Character emotion and face clear; sumptuous but field-worn fantasy uniform with subtly advanced handmade mechanisms, not sci-fi power armor.
Nestown identity: TURQUOISE BLUE and WHITE uniform, muted warm metal fittings. AERO crystalline light pale cyan with hints of mint, not fire, not electric lightning. Main new uniform feature: a real shoulder-mounted MANTEAU-REMPART made of 7-9 LARGE long overlapping forged metal FEATHER-SHAPED PLATES. Pearly silver/ivory outer faces with deep turquoise enameled tips/ridges, darker blue underside, white fabric lining visible between plates. They hang like a weighty magnificent cape when folded and mechanically FAN FORWARD from one shoulder to the corresponding forearm as a protective shield. Thin visible copper/silver hinges and forearm cuff carry their weight. One small bright faceted AERO Kalistel at shoulder clasp powers narrow restrained cyan veins through joints; discreet wisps of air curl just along feather edges. CLEARLY manufactured metallic plates, not extra organic wings, not floating feathers, not unattached conventional shield. Big shape dominates silhouette while preserving face, chest and weapon. No explosion, no particle clutter.
Keep exactly one head, two humanoid arms, two legs, credible fingers, wrists and hand grips. Weapons straight and rigid, may exit frame naturally; don't compress anatomy to fit. Generous framing suitable to card artwork, central face and gesture with breathing space. Simple background 2-3 broad shapes, varied settings, no detailed city skyline, no flags. Do not paste old face onto new body.
CHARACTER AND SCENE:
VESSA, same female FALCO falcon-like face in image1: creamy white throat with fine warm brown freckles, small dark beak, chestnut feather crown. Preserve EXACT sacred Nestown helmet: metal cap, large swept-back BLUE metal winglets, tiny blue crystal at each winglet attachment, luminous feather veins and softly shining blue goggles; head still falcon-shaped not human face. Her role is careful rescuer, compassionate vigilance, not roaring.
New full figure scene on a narrow but sturdy pale-stone aerial footbridge, looking down toward unseen people beyond lower left; feet firmly grounded. RIGHT hand firmly grips her distinctive straight rescue STAFF with horseshoe-shaped rope reel head, staff planted near right boot (may reach beyond top edge naturally), rope coil secured to belt instead of extra hands. LEFT forearm raised slightly forward toward wind, deploying pearl-white and turquoise segmented CAPE into a sheltering curved fan on left side of her body. Rear other half cape still drapes to calves, continuous attachment shoulder to forearm obvious. White scarf flutters opposite direction. Mild wind ripples air along shield edge; do not show actual people or additional limbs. Background one low stone parapet, open white clouds and pale azure sky, only a distant large soft mountain shape. Sunny cool daylight, exquisite rich brushwork; generous full figure scale.

cards.name: Karrok
cards.title: Deux rivets, puis le ciel
cards.costume: Uniforme turquoise, écharpe blanche et manteau à grandes plumes métalliques réparées.
cards.crystal: Au fermoir gauche ; les charnières déploient le rempart avec une fine lueur Aéro.
cards.scene: À l'entrée du hangar, il éprouve le déploiement du manteau qu'il vient de réparer.

original.name: KARROK
original.description: Karrok répare son bouclier avec deux rivets qui n'étaient pas prévus pour voler. Sa lance garde la route entre les plateformes. Il plaisante surtout quand ses compagnons ont peur.

cards.name: Neryk
cards.title: La plume qui reste
cards.costume: Manteau-rempart étroit, tunique turquoise et casque à ailettes porté à la ceinture.
cards.crystal: Le fermoir alimente de fines nervures bleu pâle ; le casque reste vide.
cards.scene: Elle pivote à l'entrée d'un pont suspendu, lame basse et rempart prêt.

original.name: NERYK
original.description: Neryk a noué un ruban de secours à sa lame ajourée. Elle se rappelle celle qu'elle n'a pas rattrapée. Sur les ponts du ciel, sa vitesse protège les silences autant que les vivants.

cards.name: Khariel
cards.title: Le pont ne cédera pas
cards.costume: Version lourde du manteau-rempart, uniforme turquoise et blanc et casque à hautes ailettes.
cards.crystal: Au fermoir ; la lueur Aéro souligne le verrouillage des grandes plaques.
cards.scene: Sur le pont d'un ferry aérien, il reste face à la bourrasque.

original.name: KHARIEL
original.description: Khariel reste sur le pont quand les autres replient leurs ailes. Son ancre a retenu un ferry entier dans la tempête. Depuis, une petite plume nouée au manche lui rappelle qui il a sauvé.
